description: This file contains the implementation of the Store class within the c10d namespace, providing methods for managing a key-value store with features such as timeout management, get/set, compare-and-set, append, and multi-get/multi-set operations.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Implements a key-value store with support for timeout, atomic compare-and-set, and batch operations in the c10d distributed context.

methods.name: const std::chrono::milliseconds & getTimeout() const
methods.description: Returns the current timeout duration for the store.

methods.name: void setTimeout(const std::chrono::milliseconds & timeout)
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for the store.

methods.name: void set(const std::string & key,const std::string & value)
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key.

methods.name: std::string compareSet(const std::string & key,const std::string & currentValue,const std::string & newValue)
methods.description: Atomically compares and sets the value for a key if it matches the current value.

methods.name: std::string get_to_str(const std::string & key)
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key as a string.

methods.name: void append(const std::string & key,const std::vector<uint8_t> & value)
methods.description: Appends data to the value associated with a key using compare-and-set to ensure atomicity.

methods.name: std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> multiGet(const std::vector<std::string> & keys)
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for a list of keys.

methods.name: void multiSet(const std::vector<std::string> & keys,const std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> & values)
bool hasExtendedApi() const
methods.description: Indicates whether the store supports extended API features.

ctags.name: append
ctags.pattern: /^void Store::append(const std::string& key, const std::vector<uint8_t>& value) {$/

ctags.name: compareSet
ctags.signature: (const std::string & key,const std::string & currentValue,const std::string & newValue)

ctags.name: set
ctags.pattern: /^void Store::set(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {$/
